hints.title: Filtering Target Year Records
hints.text: Filter records from the customers table where the year attribute matches 2021.

hints.title: Checking Positive Monetary Revenue
hints.text: Ensure the revenue recorded is strictly greater than 0.

hints.title: Projecting Unique Customer Identifiers
hints.text: Select the customer_id column for all matching entries.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT customer_id
FROM Customers
WHERE year = 2021 AND revenue > 0;
```

complexity.time: O(N) table scan or O(K) with composite index
complexity.notes: Predicate filtering on year and revenue thresholds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Loading entire historical revenue logs into application memory produces unnecessary bandwidth consumption.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A composite index on (year, revenue, customer_id) provides an index-only scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should provide the direct conjunction filter.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def find_customers(customers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = customers[(customers["year"] == 2021) & (customers["revenue"] > 0)]
    return df[["customer_id"]]
